objections.about: The customer's post has already lost its photo, and the reply never says how to get it back. The help page only says to pass the whole post object, and a media edit needs mediaUrls included.

Step 3's recommended flow fetches the current post and re-sends it. That post no longer has mediaUrls, so following the flow would not restore the photo. The reply leaves out that the media has to be supplied again in the update.
